name: Wave

open_questions: Wave's API docs (https://docs.wave.com/business) say a Wave Business Account is needed, but neither the docs nor wave.com (/fr/business, /en/business, the terms of each country) say whether an individual without a registered business can open one, nor which documents are required.

description: Wave is a mobile money operator active in 11 African countries offering checkout sessions for e-commerce payments and batch payouts via a REST API.
example_prompt: Add Wave checkout to my e-commerce app.
